title: Ethiopian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Ethiopia, made with tender lamb and warm spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere, tomato paste, and beef broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
